svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four. Cut 120 mm from 34.93 x 2.11 mm tube; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chamfer the outside of one end 1 mm x 45 deg: the free end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 8.5 mm for the snap button 30 mm from the free end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the V-spring button from inside, button out through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the hole. Spring legs lie flat across the bore (top to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom stays clear for the cable and guide tube).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond: the plain end goes 60 mm into the section's front end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with structural epoxy, button on the section's button line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 4.0 mm through tube and coupler, top and bottom, 30 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the section end; press in the pins flush both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 0.11 mm a side in the next tube; it must slide freely.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: pull hard by hand; nothing moves; button pops fully.
